title: Integrated discovery of SBLR876: a potent RAGE inhibitor mitigating AGE-RAGE-NF-kappaB-mediated cytotoxicity and inflammation in diabetic kidney disease.
authors: Mohammad Al Shahrani, Mesfer; Abohassan, Mohammad; Dera, Ayed A; Vijayaraghavalu, Sivakumar; Rajagopalan, Prasanna
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选、分子对接和MD模拟发现RAGE小分子抑制剂，核心是蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIM: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is a major microvascular complication characterized by chronic inflammation and fibrosis. The receptor for advanced glycation end products (RAGE) drives these processes via the AGE-RAGE-NF-kappaB axis. This study aimed to identify and validate novel small-molecule RAGE inhibitors capable of mitigating AGE-driven renal injury. METHODS: An integrated computational pipeline combining high-throughput virtual screening of the ZINC natural product library, molecular docking, 100-ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and molecular mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann surface area (MMPBSA) calculations was employed to identify RAGE modulators. ADMET analyses assessed drug-likeness. The top hit, SBLR876, was experimentally validated using AGE-RAGE binding and in vitro assays in human renal tubular epithelial (HK-2) cells. RESULTS: SBLR876 exhibited a high docking score (-7.1 kcal/mol), stable MD trajectories (RMSD <0.12 nm), and strong MMPBSA binding energy (-31.42 kcal/mol). ADMET predictions indicated good bioavailability and non-toxicity. In vitro, SBLR876 inhibited AGE-RAGE binding with an IC(50) of 282.2 nM, comparable to FPS-ZM1 (93.1 nM). In HK-2 cells, it significantly reduced AGE-induced ROS generation, restored viability, and suppressed IL-6, TNF-alpha, and MCP-1 secretion, with marked inhibition of NF-kappaB phosphorylation and nuclear translocation. CONCLUSION: This integrated computational-experimental approach identifies SBLR876 as a potent RAGE inhibitor that disrupts the AGE-RAGE-NF-kappaB cascade, offering a promising therapeutic lead for mitigating inflammation and fibrotic progression in diabetic kidney disease.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：糖尿病肾病（DKD）是一种以慢性炎症和纤维化为特征的主要微血管并发症。晚期糖基化终末产物受体（RAGE）通过AGE-RAGE-NF-kappaB轴驱动这些过程。本研究旨在识别并验证能够减轻AGE驱动的肾损伤的新型小分子RAGE抑制剂。方法：采用整合计算流程，包括对ZINC天然产物库进行高通量虚拟筛选、分子对接、100纳秒分子动力学（MD）模拟及分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MMPBSA）计算，以识别RAGE调节剂。ADMET分析评估了药物相似性。最佳候选化合物SBLR876通过AGE-RAGE结合实验及人肾小管上皮（HK-2）细胞体外实验进行了实验验证。结果：SBLR876表现出高对接分数（-7.1 kcal/mol）、稳定的MD轨迹（RMSD <0.12 nm）及强MMPBSA结合能（-31.42 kcal/mol）。ADMET预测显示其具有良好的生物利用度和无毒性。体外实验中，SBLR876抑制AGE-RAGE结合，IC(50)为282.2 nM，与FPS-ZM1（93.1 nM）相当。在HK-2细胞中，它显著降低了AGE诱导的ROS生成，恢复了细胞活力，并抑制了IL-6、TNF-alpha和MCP-1的分泌，同时显著抑制NF-kappaB磷酸化和核转位。结论：这种整合计算-实验方法将SBLR876鉴定为一种有效的RAGE抑制剂，可破坏AGE-RAGE-NF-kappaB级联反应，为减轻糖尿病肾病中的炎症和纤维化进展提供了有前景的治疗先导化合物。
